title: Saudi mobile-first software buyer
target_definition: A Saudi-market founder, co-founder, or owner with verified buying authority who is actively building or digitizing a venture, has a credible need for custom mobile or software work, lacks sufficient visible in-house delivery capacity or explicitly seeks an external builder, and shows a realistic budget or urgency signal.
geography_rule: Saudi relevance means current residence, company headquarters, or verified Saudi-market operations; never infer nationality.

lanes.label: New founder
lanes.definition: Founder role or venture began within the last 12 months and the venture has a plausible custom-software need.

lanes.label: Stealth or pre-company
lanes.definition: Verified Saudi-market founder signal and explicit product intent, but no complete company profile yet.

lanes.label: SME digital build
lanes.definition: An established Saudi operating business with a recent, specific app, platform, marketplace, or internal-software initiative.

required_gates.label: Identity
required_gates.rule: The person and current organization are verified without an unresolved collision.

required_gates.label: Saudi-market relevance
required_gates.rule: Residence, headquarters, or Saudi-market operations are confirmed by evidence.

required_gates.label: Buying authority
required_gates.rule: The person currently holds a founder, co-founder, owner, or equivalent decision role.

required_gates.label: Software fit
required_gates.rule: A plausible need for custom mobile or software work is evidenced, not assumed from title alone.

levels.rule: Unknown or no evidenced custom-software use case.
A plausible software use case is supported by the business model.
A specific app, platform, marketplace, MVP, or build was publicly described within 12 months.
A developer, vendor, technical partner, or dated build brief was explicitly requested within six months.
In-house delivery capacity is clearly sufficient.
A documented team audit finds no visible technical co-founder or engineering capacity; this remains an observation, not proof of absence.
The venture explicitly seeks an external builder, vendor, or delivery partner.
The initiative is explicitly paused or has no budget.
Operating revenue, customers, funding, a grant, accelerator support, or a credible commercial partner is evidenced.
Budget, procurement, an awarded product grant, or a paid pilot tied to the build is explicit.
The signal is undated or inactive.
The signal is older than one year but demonstrably current.
The relevant trigger occurred within 365 days.
The relevant trigger occurred within 180 days.
The relevant trigger occurred within 90 days.

penalties.rule: Sufficient internal product and engineering delivery capacity is evidenced.
The product is mature and no new build, rebuild, or expansion trigger exists.
The venture has more than 20 visible LinkedIn employees without a specific new build.
The venture is closed or dormant, or the founder role has ended.

bands.definition: All gates confirmed; strong intent, outsourcing, and budget evidence; manually reviewed.
All gates confirmed, with one high-value proof weaker than an A lead.
Plausible watchlist candidate with evidence gaps documented for refresh.
Low fit or hard-disqualified; keep outside the active lead set.

evidence_policy: Every scored claim references an evidence record with a source URL and observation date.
A and B leads require two independent sources, including one first-party or official source.
Unknown facts remain unknown; profile silence is never proof.
LinkedIn employee counts are labelled as visible bands, not payroll.
Likes, follows, newsletters, and inspirational content are discovery tags only.
Refresh role, product, team, timing, and budget claims after 90 days; refresh stable identity facts after 365 days.
exclusions: Software agency or vendor rather than buyer

reference_customers.evidence_basis: The user identified this person as an existing software-company customer who requested a mobile application.
discovery_signals: Founder of a very small company
Engages with founder and ecosystem accounts
Known verified purchase of mobile-application development
